key_quote: The phase classification is validated against mean-field-theoretic ground truth, not against actual training outcomes. Neither the classify function's predictive accuracy for training success/failure nor the initialize function's performance vs. Xavier/Kaiming/μP on real training tasks is demonstrated.
rationale: All three reviewers acknowledge the novelty of the theoretical framework (mean-field + finite-width corrections + Z3), but the system validates its predictions against its own theory rather than real training outcomes. The Gaussian moment closure (κ₄=0) is uncontrolled, 85.7% accuracy lacks failure-mode analysis, and UQ calibration is claimed but not demonstrated. Category B: genuinely novel idea needing deeper execution.
